problems.detail: Tree branches and a cobblestone-wall pole stick out through the cavern shell. Brown logs are visible on the outside of the dome in both exterior views, and a grey pole pokes out of the top (watch-house 'chimney' running y8 up to H-4).
problems.code_hint: 'for k in range(H): b.set(WX0+3, 8+k, WZ0+3, cobblestone_wall)'; trees placed without checking the shell

problems.detail: The cavern floor is a flat snow plane with sine-wave snow layers. There are no ice ridges, rock outcrops, drifts banked against walls or level changes.

The cells are flat blue-ice boxes with bars, and the watch house is a plain log box with a hip roof. Impel Down is a stone-built prison: the show's Level 5 has stone cell blocks rimed with ice, chained prisoners and a blizzard, not cube rooms of blue ice.
problems.where: U.cell_row north and east; watch house 6..22,34..62

problems.detail: The frozen prisoners are an ice block topped by a skull. The wolves' den is a snow cylinder with random bones, hay and wool on the floor.

top_fixes: Light the cavern deliberately: blue/white lanterns on short wall brackets along the cells, glowing ice (sea lanterns inside packed ice) in the spires, and a few lamp posts. In finish.place_light cap the chain length (e.g. at most 4-6 blocks, otherwise use a lamp post or wall light).
Fix the branch geometry so each step shares a face (place the riser block before stepping out), and stop trees and the pole at the shell (check b.get above, or clamp to the cavern height function).
Build the cell blocks in Impel Down stone (stone bricks, deepslate, iron bars) with frost and icicles on them, plus chained prisoners (chains hanging from ceiling hooks to a figure).
Shape the floor: snow ridges, rock and ice outcrops, drifts against walls, a few frozen-over stair levels to the upper cell tier, and a blizzard feel (powder snow patches, snow layers in streaks).
Give the den a proper cave mouth with bones and fur rugs. Give the watch house a stone base, a lit stove chimney that ends at the cave roof, and frosted windows.

problems.detail: The sea is a perfect square basin, 9 deep, with vertical cut sides and a flat grass/dirt rim all round. It looks like a swimming pool. soften_edges left out 0 columns because water columns are not 'ground', so the square stays.
problems.code_hint: build(): 'else: for y in range(-8, 1): b.set(x, y, z, WATER)' over the full N x N square

problems.detail: Laboon is a plain ellipsoid blob (27x18x17 egg) with two tiny black eyes on the sides and a mouth line. There is no tall flat forehead, flippers, blowhole, back or tail, and the Straw Hat jolly roger is painted on the top instead of the forehead face. The show's iconic interior, Crocus' island and house inside Laboon's stomach with the painted sky, is missing: the cut shows plain water inside.

Twin Capes sits at the foot of Reverse Mountain with the Red Line cliff and the river channel coming down. None of that is here: no cliff wall, no channel mouth, no rocky second cape. The 'rocky cape' is a smooth grass cone.

Crocus' deck chair is two white carpets, the parasol is commented out, and the house and clinic are small plaster boxes. The lighthouse is a hollow striped cylinder with a ladder and plank floors: no stairs, rooms or lamp mechanism.
The finish pass propped up 4 floating parts, likely gallery bars or house bits placed with the hgt() guesswork.

top_fixes: Shape the sea naturally: shallow beach shelves sloping down to deep water, rocks and sea stacks, the second cape on the far side, and no straight basin walls (or clip the water to an irregular outline so the world's own sea or terrain meets it).
Build a tall rugged Red Line cliff along one side with the river channel and waterfall coming out of Reverse Mountain into the bay.

Rebuild Laboon: a massive whale head with a tall blunt forehead facing the cape, the scarred forehead with the Straw Hat jolly roger, eyes with white rims, a mouth line, a blowhole and a fin breaking the surface. Hollow the stomach into Crocus' interior island with the painted-sky walls.
Make the cape rocky (stone, andesite, cliffs and tide pools), add Crocus' deck chair with a parasol and side table, and give the house and clinic a frame and real windows.
Give the lighthouse a stone base with a door, a spiral stair, a gallery with railing on brackets, and a lamp room with a frame.

problems.where: castle facade at z=22: the decorated side faces north (FZ-1), the house and the sea are south

Here, from the sea and the pier, you see the blank back of the facade, and all the windows, cornices, banners and crest face the jungle.

problems.where: the sea along the south side

b.ship() draws a flat sail plane split down the middle at the mast, with no yard and no belly.

problems.where: stray single dirt/grass cubes off the island edge (NW view left ~x30,y300; SE view right ~x1050,y530)
problems.detail: Lone ground blocks float off the outline.

problems.where: the Saruyama camp and the lean-to
problems.detail: The Saruyama 'tents' are solid triangles of orange and brown wool, which in the show are a monkey-themed ship and a camp. The lawn is flat grass dotted with stumps and stripes of dirt.

top_fixes: Turn the composition round: put the decorated castle face toward the sea and the pier (ornament on the +z side), with the shack and jungle behind it
Give the back of the facade timber bracing, raking props down to the ground, exposed floor beams and the sliced rooms at the cut edge
Make the cut edge ragged, with broken floor slabs, a half room and a torn banner, instead of a stepped drop
Reshape the sea: an irregular cove with a sloping beach and rocks instead of a straight trench
Swap B.ship's flat sail for canvas.square_sail (fixes every module that uses b.ship)
Build the Saruyama camp as Masira's monkey-head salvage ship and a proper camp, not solid wool wedges

problems.detail: The trunk is a perfectly round, perfectly straight cylinder with a gentle taper. It looks like a factory chimney: no buttress flutes, no twist, no bark ridges, no burls and no branches until the crown. Elbaph's Treasure Tree Adam is gnarled, with enormous twisting limbs, and its crown carries a whole world above the clouds.
problems.code_hint: elbaph_tree.py: `b.cyl(TX, TZ, r, y, y, ADAM)` per layer, r depends on y only

problems.detail: The crown is four squashed spheres of the same spruce leaves (ry=0.45r), so it reads as stacked green pancakes with contour rings. There are no visible limbs, no gaps, no hanging moss and no colour variation.
problems.code_hint: sphere(... ry=r*0.45) for 4 lobes; only 6 straight `b.line` branches, all hidden inside

problems.detail: The roots are eight flat-topped ramps in a perfect star (k*pi/4). They read as a brown starfish, not roots arching out of the ground.
problems.code_hint: roots loop: `b.cyl(rx, rz, rr, 0, h)` filled solid from y0

problems.detail: The longhouses are plain log boxes with zero windows and flat gable walls, and the roof is stripes of planks. The dragon heads are a stick of logs with a 3x3 plank cube on top. Viking giant halls should have carved ridge beams, crossed gable horns, shields along the walls and a porch.
The podzol is placed on a regular `(x*3+z) % 7 == 0` pattern, which shows as perfectly straight diagonal lines of brown dots over all the snow. The ground is otherwise flat white.
problems.code_hint: elbaph_tree.py build(): `if (x * 3 + z) % 7 == 0: b.set(x, 0, z, podzol)`

problems.where: the lookout platform at TX+34,y86 and the training-ring weapons
problems.detail: The finish report says 'big floating part kept=1' and 'removed floating lantern=8'. The bough-tip platform is a flat disc perched on the end of a thin limb. The giant axe head is a one-block-thick iron triangle and the sword's gold guard sticks out sideways, so both read as flat cutouts.
The hollow is an empty tube with a thin spiral of planks. There are no rooms, landings or windows in the bark.

top_fixes: Rebuild the trunk with noise-driven radius per angle (flutes and buttresses), a slight twist, bark ridges, knots and 4-6 huge limbs that leave the trunk at different heights and fork into the crown
Make the crown out of many lobes of mixed leaves (spruce, dark oak, azalea) on visible limbs, with gaps, hanging vines and a few giant houses or platforms on the limbs
Make the roots arch: raise them off the ground in the middle with a tunnel underneath, vary their count and angle, and give them taper and bends
Remove the modular podzol pattern; scatter it with noise, and add rocks, pine clusters and snow drifts
Give the longhouses windows, shields, carved crossed gable horns, stone bases and porches; make the dragon heads real carved shapes
Make the giant weapons 3D (axe head 3 thick with a curved edge, sword with fuller and pommel) and give the bough platform a proper strut/railing

problems.where: the seastone drum below the surface
problems.detail: The drum is a perfect banded cylinder (stripes every 3 blocks), 60 deep, with no buttresses, no base and no shape change.

Impel Down above water is a massive dark-grey castle rising out of open sea, with the giant entrance gate, a domed or conical top and the Gates of Justice nearby. Here there is a ring of small crenellated towers round a flat grey disc, a central tower topped by a flat cage, and a ring of grass and dirt around it, which makes no sense for a prison in the Calm Belt.
The courtyard is a featureless grey andesite disc with a few loose fence posts and a spiral of seastone. There is no paving pattern, gatehouse or barracks layout.

Each level is one huge open disc 8 high with a thin ring of bars at the wall. Lv3 is flat sand with scattered posts. Lv6 is pure black with a few purple bits. Lv1's 'blade trees' are random red blobs. None has cell blocks you would recognise, catwalks, stair shafts, the giant Lv4 cauldron hall or warden areas at scale.
The flag is a flat white plate with a blue square.

problems.where: grass/dirt apron around the drum at y0
problems.detail: A ring of grass terrain hangs round the outside of the drum at sea level. With terrain='none' at sea it is a floating lawn collar.

top_fixes: Reshape the above-water fortress into the show's massive gate building: tall dark walls rising from the sea, the giant entrance, and a stepped dome or cone, instead of small round towers on a flat plate
Remove the grass apron; make it rock/seastone rising out of water

Fill each level with real cell blocks in rings or radial wings, catwalks over the central hell, stairs between levels, and the themed set pieces at scale (Lv1 blade forest, Lv2 beast pens, Lv4 lava cauldron and bridge, Lv5 frozen cells)
Vary the drum: buttress ribs, the waterline, barnacled base, bigger setbacks
Light Lv6 with sparse blue lamps and give it heavy individual cells instead of a black void

problems.detail: The mountain is a smooth Gaussian bump only 36 high, almost all moss, so it reads as a dark green blob. The 'cliff-ringed mountain' has no cliffs, ledges, overhangs or rock faces. The waterfall is a thin 3-wide blue staircase down one side.
problems.code_hint: rusukaina.py: `h = int(36*exp(-(d/13)**2))` with moss on top

problems.detail: All 26 trees are the same lollipop: a straight 3-wide cylinder trunk and a squashed leaf sphere. They have no buttress roots, branches, height layers or undergrowth canopy.
The 'giant tree Luffy knocked down' renders as a flat brown ramp or path. It has no bark, roots, stump or broken branches.
The sea is a straight rectangular channel with a uniform sand strip, like the Cricket and Yuba coasts.

Rusukaina is a brutal island of extreme seasons with huge beasts. Luffy's training spots include the cliffs he smashes, giant beast lairs and Rayleigh's camp. The bone nests here are small hay rings with a bone circle. There is no giant beast skull or skeleton landmark, no punched-through boulders at scale, and Rayleigh's tent isn't readable.
The tents are solid triangular wedges of wool, with no poles, flaps or ropes.

top_fixes: Rebuild the mountain with noise and terracing: real stone cliffs, ledges, a gorge with a proper waterfall and plunge pool, moss only on the flats
Vary the jungle: 3-4 tree shapes with buttress roots, side limbs, layered canopies, low palms and big ferns underneath
Make the fallen tree a real trunk: bark texture, a torn stump with roots, broken limbs, lying on the ground at an angle
Add a giant beast skeleton or skull landmark, big cracked boulders with fist craters, and a clear Rayleigh beach camp with a lean-to
Give the coast an irregular cove with rocks instead of a straight channel

problems.detail: The Tree of Knowledge trunk is a perfect straight cylinder of oak wood, radius 14 and 48 high. It has no flare, no bark texture, no knots, no windows and no branches, so from outside it is a giant brown pillar.

The canopy is 4 leaf ellipsoids with no branches. The side blobs hover out over empty air with nothing connecting them to the trunk, and the crown looks like a mushroom cap on a post. The glass dome shows as a light-blue ring in the gap between trunk and leaves. The gallery lanterns are hung at the open inner edge of each gallery with nothing above them, and the finish pass removed 14 floating lanterns.

In the anime the Tree of Knowledge has rows of windows and doors cut into the trunk, a grand stair entrance, massive gnarled roots and branches spreading wide. Here the only opening is a 3-wide tunnel on the west side. The houses use the red-roofed timber 'plaster' style, although the module itself says the white houses have blue roofs.
Robin's reading cliff is a stone box with a grass box on top. The sea is a straight channel cut along the east edge.
The six galleries are identical rings with lecterns on the same pattern, and the reading room is a generic furnish('library').

top_fixes: Sculpt the trunk: flare it at the base, add a noise-perturbed radius with bark ridges (oak/spruce/stripped variants), and cut rows of arched windows with frames, balconies and a grand double door up a stair.

Grow real branches from the top of the trunk (thick log lines that split and taper) and hang the leaf masses on them, so the canopy is carried. Hide the dome under a leafy opening or a framed skylight.
Restyle the scholars' village: white plaster houses with blue roofs, varied sizes, gardens and a lane down to the harbour.
Hang the gallery lanterns from the ceiling or the gallery underside with chains, and vary the galleries (map tables, globes, scroll racks, ladders).
Make Robin's cliff a natural headland with a slope, a tree and rocks, and give the coastline curves and beach.

problems.detail: Every giant tree is a straight cylinder trunk with one huge flattened leaf ellipsoid on top (a lollipop). The branches are hidden inside the canopy, the trunks have no taper, buttress roots or texture, and the trees differ only in size.
problems.code_hint: giant_tree(): b.sphere(x, h+3, z, r*3.2, LEAF, ry=r*1.5)

problems.where: rope bridges between the tree decks
problems.detail: Each bridge is a single line of jungle slabs stepping diagonally, with a fence only every 4th step. The slabs touch only at corners and there is no rope or chain, so the bridges read as dotted lines in the air.
problems.code_hint: bridge(): b.set(round(bx), by, round(bz), 'jungle_slab[type=top]'); fences only if i % 4 == 0

problems.detail: A flat lawn with grass and fern tufts. Nothing says this is the back of the elephant Zunesha: no hide-coloured rock, no ridged terrain.

In the anime Zou has the Whale Tree (an enormous tree with a whale-shaped trunk and roots), Kurau City with round stone and wooden buildings and bathhouses, and paths lit by lanterns, all set in a dense tall forest. Here Kurau City is six generic orange T.house boxes, and the market stalls are hidden in a row under a canopy.
The roofs are concentric hay and moss rings that read as yellow-green stripes. Each tree house has only 3 single panes and furnishes a 3x3 box on one side.
Three stacked 7x7 rooms inside a cylinder, linked by one ladder, with single panes; no carved, organic interior.

top_fixes: Rebuild the giant trees with tapering trunks, buttress roots, visible branches and several leaf clusters at different heights
Make the Whale Tree unmistakable: much larger, with a whale-like trunk and a grand carved entrance
Make the bridges solid walkable plank decks with rope (chain or fence) handrails on both sides and hanging lanterns
Give the ground the feel of Zunesha's back: rolling, ridged terrain in grey and brown
Replace the Kurau City boxes with round Mink houses with domed roofs and lantern-lit streets, and bring the market out into the open
Use thatched or shingled conical roofs on the tree houses instead of hay and moss rings

problems.detail: The keep is a plain light-grey snow-brick box: single-block walls with 1x2 pane slits every 3 blocks, and no frame, buttresses, set-backs or trim. A jagged ice crown sits on a flat top. It is the dullest object in the build and it is in the middle.

The two frozen Marine ships use the legacy kit.ship from tools/worldgen/kit.py. It draws each sail as a flat one-block sheet of white wool, and the 'flag' as a light-blue wool box. The hulls read as low rafts in the ice.
problems.code_hint: b.ship(... sail='minecraft:white_wool') -> worldgen/kit.py ship(): 'self.set(x0+mx+1, y, z, sail)'

problems.detail: The curtain walls are flat planes of packed ice with crenellations. There are no buttresses, icicle fringes, frozen cracks or colour gradient from blue ice up to packed ice and snow.

The 'frozen wave curling over the gate' renders as a straight stepped ramp of ice. Aokiji's signature in the show is huge frozen tsunami walls and spiky ice fields (Marineford, Punk Hazard): jagged, overhanging, translucent. The towers are stacked cylinders with stepped cones, more sandcastle than ice.
The courtyard is a flat snow/ice floor with a near-checker pattern. Outside, the frozen bay is a flat square sheet with random 1-block ice cubes scattered on the snow.
The keep floors are I.subdivide grids of rooms with spruce floors. They do not feel like Aokiji's base: no lazy bedroom scene, no frost, and the bicycle and sleep mask are a couple of blocks.

top_fixes: Rebuild the keep with depth: ice-pillar frame posts every 3-4 blocks, a two-block-deep window reveal with blue-ice sills, a stepped set-back upper floor, corner turrets, icicle fringes hanging from every cornice and a gradient from blue ice up to packed ice and snow.
Replace b.ship with the canvas hull + square_sail helpers (billowing, torn, frost-covered sails) and heel the frozen ships over at an angle, locked into big ice ridges up their sides.
Make the frozen wave a real curl: a tall overhanging arc of ice built from stacked offset ellipses, with spray spikes along its crest.
Break the curtain walls with buttresses and jagged ice spikes growing out of them, and replace the stacked-cylinder towers with faceted crystal towers that lean slightly.
Texture the ground: pressure ridges and cracked plates in the frozen bay, snow drifts against the walls, no checker pattern.

problems.where: town below the plateau, the two blocks of houses south-west and south-east of the stair
problems.detail: About 30 identical flat-roofed sandstone cubes in a strict grid, each with x%2 crenellations and one wool awning. This is exactly the Nanohana look ryan hates. No height variety, no domes, no stairs to the roof, no arches, no lanes between them.
problems.code_hint: alubarna.house(): b.walls + b.box roof + `wall(SAND_W) if x % 2` parapet, placed on a regular grid in build()

problems.where: outer palace curtain wall along all four plateau edges, and the long sides of the main palace block
problems.detail: The outer wall is one block thick and 10 tall, plain sandstone with a single cut-sandstone band at PLAT+3. No buttresses, set-backs, arrow slits, machicolations or a walkway. The palace wings are flat boxes with small window slits and a flat roof.
problems.code_hint: build(): `b.box(x, PLAT+1, z, x, PLAT+WH, z, SAND)` loops for PZ0/PZ1/PX0/PX1

problems.where: the plateau top inside the walls, and the plaza (z 118..190)
problems.detail: The plateau is a perfect rectangle (PX0..PX1, PZ0..PZ1), and its top is one flat smooth-sandstone plate with two square pools and a few palms. The plaza is a 3x3 checkerboard of smooth and cut sandstone. The cliff is solid fill: cut 10 shows that the whole plateau is a single slab with a sandstone swirl pattern and no tomb or cellars beyond one small room.
problems.code_hint: `SMOOTH if (x // 3 + z // 3) % 2 else CUT` plaza checker; `b.box(PX0, PLAT, PZ0, PX1, PLAT, PZ1, SMOOTH)`

problems.detail: In the anime Alubarna is a city of round-cornered cubic houses climbing terraces round a central rock. The palace sits on the summit, with a big central onion dome flanked by slim minarets, colonnaded balconies, and the palace front with its tall pillared portico above the grand stairway. Here the domes are grey-white blobs with no gold banding or ribs, and the palace front has no portico. The city is not terraced, and the clock tower (accurate) stands alone on an empty plaza.

problems.where: under the SE plateau slope near (1470,845) in the SE view
problems.detail: A single stray sandstone block floats below the eroded cliff edge.

The palace wings are long corridors of tiny identical rooms, and the throne hall is a bare red carpet between thin posts. It has no arcade, no rib vault and no dais of note, unlike the sandstone throne hall reference.

top_fixes: Replace alubarna.house() with varied Alabasta houses: 1 to 3 storeys, rounded or chamfered corners, small domes on some roofs, roof terraces with stair access, arched doorways, and cloth awnings on poles. Cluster them along curving lanes stepping up terraces toward the plateau, not on a grid.
Break the curtain wall: make it 2-3 thick with a crenellated walkway, buttresses or pilasters every 8 blocks, a cut-sandstone plinth and cornice, and an arched gallery on the inside face.

Give the palace front a tall pillared portico with pointed arches above the grand stair, and stepped set-backs on the wings. Rib the big dome and band it in gold, with a gold finial and a drum of arched windows.
Turn the plateau top into gardens: raised planters, paths, fountains and arcades round the pools instead of a flat plate, with an irregular (not rectangular) cliff outline.
Make the throne hall a real arcade hall with columns, arches, a raised dais, banners and a vaulted ceiling, and hollow out the royal tomb with the Poneglyph inside the cliff.
Replace the plaza checkerboard with a radial paving pattern and randomised variants.

problems.where: the lodge clearing (x 18..62, z 30..64) and the whole slope
problems.detail: The ground is a flat lawn with a regular dotted pattern. Coarse dirt on (x+z)%4 gives diagonal stripes, and podzol on (x*3+z)%5 gives a lattice. The 'mountain' is six even 1-block terraces in straight rows (hgt = (40-z)/6), not a slope.
problems.code_hint: dadan_hideout.build(): `coarse_dirt if (x + z) % 4 == 0`, `podzol if (x * 3 + z) % 5 == 0`, hgt()

problems.detail: A clean, symmetric dark-oak barn with one straight gable roof and walls so dark they read black. It is far too tidy for a bandit hut. There is a small porch roof and one extension, but no clutter, patches, chimney smoke, laundry lines or barrels outside.

In the anime, Dadan's house is a ramshackle, patched wooden shack on a steep forest slope of Mt. Colubo. It has a big front porch, a smoking chimney, stacked firewood and bandits lounging around. The forest of huge trees towers over it, and the treehouse is high in a giant tree up the slope. The treehouse here is good, but the lodge is a generic barn and the trees are uniform lollipops (log plus leaf sphere).
Every tree is a straight log with a single leaf ellipsoid on top (b.sphere). There are no roots, branches or layered canopy, so they read as lollipops in a grid-like scatter.
One long hall and a few small rooms. Not much bandit clutter (sake barrels, piled loot, hammocks, weapons on the walls).

top_fixes: Replace the ground with a smooth noise slope: real hill heights with stair and slab blending, patches of coarse dirt, podzol, moss and path chosen by noise rather than modulo stripes, and boulders, roots and fallen logs.

Rough up the lodge: uneven log ends, mixed spruce, oak and stripped logs, plank patches, a crooked roof with overhang and brackets, a stone chimney with a campfire, a deep front porch with railings, laundry lines, a woodpile and barrels.
Grow the trees properly: thick 2x2 trunks for the big ones, branches, roots, layered canopies and some giant trees around the treehouse.
Put the lodge on a cut terrace in the slope with a stone retaining wall and steps, so it reads as a mountain hideout.
Fill the interior with bandit clutter: a long table with sake barrels, hammocks and bunks, weapons racks and loot piles.

problems.where: the lawn inside the estate wall
problems.detail: The inside lawn is a perfectly square, flat grass plate with an obvious moss grid from (x*z)%5==0, so straight lines run every 5 blocks. Outside the wall is a flat podzol ring.
The 'bamboo grove' is single bamboo columns stuck one per cell at random heights, a field of green sticks with no clumps. In the render it reads as straight poles on bare dirt.

A square walled box with plain white walls and a long rectangular main house. The pagoda_roof roofs are low and flat-looking, with no visible curve or flared eaves. Everything sits on one perfectly square plate.

Kuri (Kamazo/Killer's area) is a barren, dusty wasteland around the ruins of Oden Castle, with Ebisu Town's shacks and the polluted, scarred landscape. A pristine cherry-blossom samurai estate with a koi pond is Flower Capital or Ringo style, not Kuri. Killer as Kamazo is linked to Orochi's assassins and to the Udon prison, so a hideout should look rough, ruined and hidden.
There is one big floating part (kept) and one removed bit.

top_fixes: Redesign for Kuri: dry, cracked ground (coarse dirt, gravel, dead bushes), ruined walls and burned timber around a half-collapsed estate, near Oden Castle ruins or in rocky hills.
Replace the modulo moss grid with noise patches, and give the yard slight height changes, stepping-stone paths and raked gravel.
If bamboo stays, plant it in dense clumps of 3-8 with leaves, shorter edge stalks and undergrowth, not one stalk per cell.
Steepen the roofs with curved eaves (top-half stairs and slab flares at the corners), bargeboards and ridge tiles. Vary the wall with timber posts every 3 blocks.
Add Killer's touches: a scythe/blade rack, the Kamazo mask on a stand, slashed training posts and a hidden escape tunnel.

problems.detail: The grass is covered in a perfect grey gravel grid of lines every 5 blocks, because `gravel if (x * z) % 5 == 0` is true whenever x or z is a multiple of 5. It looks like graph paper.

The hull is a long straight-sided box, red and black, with a flat deck and a rectangular stern castle. There is no sheer (deck curve), no tumblehome, and no scrap-metal plating patches, even though the docstring promises them.
A plain copper-walled box with a flat checkered (x+z)%3 roof.
The scrap heaps are random noise cones of mixed metal blocks, which read as coloured gravel piles. No recognisable parts (gears, pipes, chains, anchors).

The Victoria Punk in the anime has a dark hull with a big horned skull figurehead and red sails with Kid's jolly roger (skull with flame-like hair and crossed bones/pistons). The figurehead skull here is a ball with black dots and stubby horns. The sails billow somewhat (square_sail belly=2), but the mark is a small blob. The flag is fine.
The tents are wool triangles with no poles or ropes. The mooring posts are 2-block stumps with no ropes to the ship. The gangway is a single slab stair line.

top_fixes: Replace the modulo gravel grid with noise-based gravel and coarse-dirt patches and trodden paths (path blocks) between the camp pieces.

Shape the hull: deck sheer rising to bow and stern, tumblehome, a raised forecastle, and riveted iron and copper plates patched over the red planks. Make the stern castle stepped with windows and galleries.
Rebuild the figurehead as a big sculpted horned skull with deep eye sockets, cheekbones, teeth and long curving horns. Paint Kid's mark large across the main sail.

Make the scrap heaps recognisable: anchors, chains, gears (grindstones), pipes (lightning rods or copper), broken cannons, at varied heights. Give Killer's workshop a slanted corrugated roof and a lean-to.
Rope the ship to the mooring posts with chains or leads, give the tents poles and guy-ropes, and build a proper plank gangway with rails.

problems.detail: The Perfume Yuda's sail is two flat purple wool rectangles split by the mast. b.ship in kit.py draws every sail as a flat plane at x0+mx+1, with no yard and no belly.

The Perfume Yuda is a plain generic hull with a box cabin. It has no snake-head figurehead and no snake-scale hull. The two Yuda serpents pulling it are short submerged lime cylinders that barely show.

The Kuja Palace is one rectangular purple-terracotta box with a flat smooth-quartz roof slab and a huge purple concrete onion dome that is too big for it. The four gold domes sit on thin plain quartz drums. The walls are flat: pillars every 4 blocks, no setbacks, no tiers, no balconies, no eaves. In the anime the palace is layered and tiered, with stacked gold-and-purple roofs and snake motifs.
The palace has one floor of furnish() rooms behind plain purple dividing walls. The upper floor is a flat jungle-plank deck. Hancock's throne hall has no dais, no snake throne and no arcade.

The village huts are stacked rings of alternating purple wool and hay bales, so they read as striped beehives or cupcakes. The anime town has round stucco houses with bulbous, mushroom-like roofs, snake carvings and a lush jungle market. The two 'snake statues' are crude green helix columns.

Inside the cliff ring the city floor is one flat lawn at y0 with scattered grass, and the palace sits on a plain quartz slab. There are no terraces up to the palace, no jungle trees and no rise in the ground. The cliff ring's inner face is a sheer, uniform grey stone wall all the way round.
problems.code_hint: amazon_lily.py:57-64 ring cliffs (stone fill, grass only at the top)

problems.detail: The battle arena is a sandstone cylinder stepping out ring by ring, with two stone spheres for the petrified snakes. There are no seats, no arches and no detail.

top_fixes: Draw the Perfume Yuda with b.hull plus b.square_sail (billowing purple sails with a gold Kuja mark), add a coiled snake-head figurehead, and model the two Yuda serpents as visible arched bodies breaking the water with reared heads.

Rebuild the palace as a tiered composition: a stepped base, a recessed upper storey, purple tiled pagoda-like eaves with gold trim, balconies, and a smaller onion dome on a drum. Use real snake statues (scaled bodies, open jaws) flanking a grand stair.
Replace the striped-cone huts with round stucco houses: a mud or terracotta base with frame posts, bulbous purple/gold domed roofs with overhangs, snake-carved door frames and flower boxes.
Give the city ground shape: terraces stepping up to the palace, jungle trees and vines, paved plazas, and a river or stream. Break the inner cliff wall with ledges, waterfalls and hanging vines.
Make the arena a proper colosseum: tiered stone seating, an arcade of arches, banners, and an entrance gate with a snake crest.

problems.detail: The top of Giant Jack is supposed to hold the Golden Belfry (Shandora's great golden bell) on its cloud. Instead there is a grey box of ruin stone with a Japanese pagoda roof of gold bricks and 'torii' posts. The Golden Bell, the gold city remains and the Shandian style (stepped Mayan/Inca masonry) are all missing.

The finish pass removed 66 floating bits, and the build reports 'propped up floating part=4'. The leaf pads are single-layer discs sticking straight out with no stem. The 'rope bridges' to the ordeal shrines are a single line of top slabs with no rope, rails or posts. The ruin lintel slab at y8 sits over a 4-high column. The lanterns hang on chains with nothing visibly holding them.
problems.where: stalk leaf pads, shrine bridges, ruin at x64 z14
problems.code_hint: giant_jack.py:46-50 leaf pads, 85-86 bridges, 120-121 ruin slab

problems.detail: The beanstalk is a stack of cylinders alternating moss and green concrete every 5 blocks, which gives horizontal banding. It has no taper of form, no knots, no tendril curls and no giant bean pods. The ordeal shrines are identical stone cylinders with the same pagoda roof.
Upper Yard at the foot is a flat square lawn with lollipop jungle trees (log cylinders with one leaf ellipsoid). The Shandian ruins are 5 bare columns and a small stepped altar.
The cloud platform is a flat white disc 4 layers thick, with a ring of cloud puff at its edge. There are no cloud bumps, no Milky Road and no layered or billowing volume.

top_fixes: Put the Golden Belfry on top: a stepped Shandian stone tower with a large gold bell (sphere/dome of gold blocks with a clapper), and gold ruins of the city of Shandora around it. Drop the pagoda roofs and torii.
Give the cloud volume: puffy lobes of island_cloud and cloud_puff at different heights, rolling down the stalk a little, so it reads as a cloud and not a plate.
Sculpt the stalk: a smoother twist with spiralling secondary vines, curly tendrils and giant leaves on short stems with 2-layer leaf blades. Use moss/green gradients instead of 5-block bands.
Make the bridges real rope bridges: posts at both ends, chain or fence railings, slats with gaps, a slight sag. Attach every leaf pad and lantern visibly.

Turn Upper Yard into a giant forest on uneven ground with buttress roots, and give the Shandian ruins (Mayan-style stepped walls, carved faces, a fallen temple) more presence. Make the ordeal shrines differ (ball fields, a swamp pool, a string web, an iron grove).

problems.where: Skull Dome face (north side, NW view)
problems.detail: The face does not read as a skull. It shows a tall slit, a huge round hole in the middle and a smaller slanted hole, scattered across a smooth ball, with no brow ridge, cheekbones or jaw silhouette. The teeth are a row of flat white slabs. From the back and sides (SE view) it is a featureless cream ball with two banana horns.
problems.code_hint: in_skull()/the eye and nose carving in the Skull Dome section

problems.detail: In the anime Kaido's castle, a large multi-tier Japanese castle, rises from the crown of the Skull Dome next to the rooftop battleground. Here only a tiny one-storey hut sits on top, and the castle is hidden inside the dome.

The island is a flat disc of speckled gravel, dirt and stone noise with a stone rim wall round it. The skull sits on a low ring of rubble instead of on top of a towering rocky mountain, as in the show.

problems.where: crags and watch pagodas round the island
problems.detail: The 'crags' are the same stacked grey cone shapes repeated about 20 times, like spinning tops in a ring. The three watch pagodas are identical.

problems.where: cut30 Live Floor, cut60 castle level
problems.detail: The Live Floor is a huge brown floor with scattered tables, a fenced purple stage and plain white box buildings at the sides. The dome interior is a vast empty volume with lamps on long lines hung off the wall. The castle inside is small for the space.
The torii row is good, but it runs straight on a flat grey road across flat ground.

top_fixes: Sculpt a readable skull face: a heavy brow ridge, two large deep-set eye sockets side by side, an inverted-heart nose cavity, cheekbones, and a jaw line with big square teeth (calcite/bone with dark gaps). Add cracks and bone shading.
Put Kaido's castle on the crown: a 4-5 tier Japanese castle with curved roofs, gables and a stone base, rising behind the horns. Keep the flat rooftop battleground in front of it.
Raise the skull on a craggy mountain of dark stone with cliffs, ledges, waterfalls and paths. Replace the repeated cone crags with irregular rock formations of varied size made with noise.

Fill the Live Floor like the anime's banquet: a multi-level hall with buildings, balconies and stairs lining both sides, a big stage with lanterns and banners, food stalls, and the dome ceiling with hanging red lanterns on chains.

problems.where: main house roof and the side wings
problems.detail: The roofs are huge dark slate planes with almost no pitch. pagoda_roof over a 22x16 half-span with 1 layer comes out as a flat lid, and the upper storey is buried under it. Wano roofs should be steep, curved kawara roofs with ridges, flared corners and gables (chidori-hafu / kara-hafu).

A perfectly square 4-high white concrete wall with a single row of roof tiles on top. It has no tile coping with eaves, no posts, no stone base course with texture and no gates other than the front. White concrete reads flat.

A flat lawn with 1-wide gravel paths. There is no raked karesansui gravel, no moss mounds, no stepping stones, no bamboo, no shaped shrubs and no rocks round the pond. The sakura are identical lollipop spheres spaced evenly.
Cut3 shows the bell tower as four bare posts on grass with nothing between them. It has no base platform, railing or bracing.

Oden's Kozuki estate and Wano samurai houses in the anime have dark timber frames, white plaster panels, deep engawa verandas under wide eaves, layered curved roofs, lanterns, red lacquer accents, and gardens with rocks, bamboo and a red arched bridge. The bridge here is a red blob, not an arched taiko-bashi, and the shrine is a red concrete box.
The upper floor is a grid of identical small rooms. The ground floor audience hall is decent, but the side rooms are sparse.

top_fixes: Rebuild the roofs: a steep irimoya roof (hip plus gable) per storey with a real rise, flared corners, a ridge with onigawara end caps, gable boards, and a lower skirt roof over a visible upper storey.

Give the walls Wano grammar: dark timber posts every 3 blocks with white plaster (calcite or white terracotta, not concrete) panels, shoji and lattice windows, an engawa veranda of planks with posts, and a stone base.
Add the tile coping to the compound wall: stairs both sides with a ridge, posts, a stone base course, and a proper gatehouse with doors and a roof gable.

Landscape the garden: a raked gravel field with set rocks, moss mounds, stepping stones, bamboo groves, shaped bushes, an irregular rocky pond edge, and an arched red taiko bridge. Vary the sakura sizes and shapes.
Make the bell tower a raised stone platform with bracing, a railing and a hanging bell under a curved roof. Make the shrine wooden with a gable roof and an offering box.

problems.where: outer curtain wall, all four sides (x/z 2..102, y 1-13)
problems.detail: The 13-high outer wall is a solid slab of dressrosa_stucco with only one cut_red_sandstone stripe at y2 and y13 and alternating-block crenels. There are no buttresses, set-backs, wall-walk overhang or brackets on the outside face, so from outside the compound reads as a beige box.
problems.code_hint: arlong_park.build: b.box(x0,1,z0,x1,H,z1,WALL) for the 4 wall strips; the posts (b.column POST) are on the INNER face only

problems.detail: The courtyard is one flat smooth_stone plate with a stone_brick dot every 6 blocks, which gives a grey graph-paper look. There are no paving patterns, no drains, no worn paths, no level changes and no planters. The pool is a perfect ellipse with a uniform wall rim.
problems.code_hint: b.box(0,0,0,N,0,N,PAVE) + the PAVE2 dot grid; the pool uses d<=1.0 ellipse

problems.where: courtyard, 4 posts at (28,84),(76,84),(28,36),(76,36) plus the wall posts
problems.detail: Lone 5-high red mangrove posts with a lantern stand in the middle of the empty courtyard, connected to nothing. They read as leftover pillars.

In the show the ARLONG PARK lettering sits big and bold over the gate. Here the sign board sits under the gate's own pagoda roof (pagoda_roof at H+10, hd=5), which overhangs it, so in the SE render the blue letters are a navy smear under the eave. The gate also lacks the shark-tooth/fish motif.

problems.where: east/west barracks (x 6-20 and 84-98, z 40-84) and the main-hall wings
problems.detail: Long identical rectangular halls with posts every 4 blocks and one roof each. The two barracks are mirror copies with the same 3-layer roof, and the inside is a single row of beds 3 apart, like a dormitory grid.
Rows of identical beds and table_sets on bare spruce floors. There are no rugs, no internal arcade and no fish-man touches (aquariums, kelp, sea-stone).

top_fixes: Give the outer wall real depth: buttresses every 8-10 blocks on the OUTSIDE, a corbelled wall-walk overhang with upside-down stairs, a stone plinth at the foot, and a change of material (stone base, stucco above, teal tile coping) instead of one stucco slab.

Break up the courtyard: patterned paving (stone bricks with a border, mossy and cracked mix), worn paths to the gate and tower, a few raised planters with palms, and an irregular rocky pool edge with steps into the water.
Remove the free-standing lantern posts or turn them into proper stone lanterns on bases, and put the barrels, weapon racks and tents against walls.
Move the ARLONG PARK sign below the gate roof's eave line, or raise the roof, and make the letters bigger and white-on-blue the way the show has them. Add shark fins or teeth on the gate.
Vary the side barracks: different lengths, a covered veranda on posts facing the pool, side gables, and furnish them with hammocks, sea chests, kelp and aquarium tanks rather than a bed grid.

problems.where: the Birdcage strings, a dome of radius 50 to y110 over the whole map
problems.detail: The strings are single white_stained_glass_panes placed by stepping one axis at a time, so the panes never connect. They render as hundreds of short dashed white sticks hanging in the air over the town and through the palace, which reads as floating debris rather than taut strings. They also only exist where b.get() is None, so they are broken wherever they cross a roof.
problems.code_hint: dressrosa_palace.build: the Birdcage section, put() with white_stained_glass_pane

problems.detail: The 'natural mesa' is a perfect axis-aligned rectangle with dead-vertical walls and a perfectly flat top. The ribs only add 1-3 block bumps, so from every angle it reads as a giant grey box the palace sits on.
problems.code_hint: for x in range(P0,P1+1): for z in range(Q0,Q1+1): fills rock; ribs() depth 0..3

problems.detail: Dressrosa's town is a dense, sunny Spanish/Mediterranean jumble of pastel houses, arcades, plazas and the Corrida colosseum. Here it is a rigid 22-block grid with 4 small boxes per block, all hip-roofed pyramids of the same tile, on checkerboard mosaic streets. This is exactly the 'Nanohana' look ryan hates.
problems.code_hint: for bx in range(0,N,22): for bz ...: for (ox,oz) in ((4,4),(12,4),(4,12),(12,12)): town_house(...)

problems.where: the grass blocks between streets and the plateau top
problems.detail: Each town block is a flat grass square with scattered single flowers. The plateau top is a flat lawn whose rows of rose bushes, azalea and log stubs render as a field of green stalks. There are no plazas, terraces or level changes.
problems.code_hint: flower loop r<0.10 / sunflowers; the courtyard garden rows

problems.detail: The palace is a single rectangular block with pilasters every 4 blocks and identical windows on every floor, and a hip roof sunk behind the balustrade. There are no wings, set-backs, loggias or balconies. The keep is just a round pink cylinder.

problems.where: grand stair on the south face
problems.detail: The quartz stair is a straight 24-step ramp with sheer quartz side walls, glued to the plateau face like a slide.
problems.code_hint: grand stair loop i in range(PLAT)

top_fixes: Redo the Birdcage as continuous lines that actually join, such as white wool or white concrete one-block strings or connected iron-bars-style panes on clean straight segments (one axis per run). Use fewer, thicker strings anchored to the ground, or drop it, because the dashed sticks look like garbage.

Make the plateau a natural rock: an irregular noise-driven outline, a battered and stepped profile with ledges and overhangs, strata, waterfalls or ivy curtains, and a rounded rim. The top should have terraces and a winding switchback road or lift instead of one straight ramp.

Break the town grid: irregular, curving streets, plazas with fountains, varied house sizes and rooflines (gables, towers, balconies, arcades, flat terraces), and the Corrida colosseum or flower fields as landmarks. No two houses side by side alike.

Give the palace massing: projecting wings and a central pavilion, an arcaded loggia on the ground floor, balconies, and tall slender cone-roofed towers of different heights around a taller central spire. Use more pink and white contrast, as in the anime.
Turn the plateau garden into a designed courtyard (paths, hedged parterres, flowering trees) instead of rows of stalks.

problems.where: the city: 4 rows of machiya z 61-110

top_fixes: Replace the grid of identical machiya with a varied street plan: a main avenue plus crooked side lanes, buildings of different widths and heights (1-3 storeys), roofs turned both ways, kura storehouses, a big teahouse with a curved karahafu gable, and alleys between them.

Build a real curved ishigaki: a concave-profile batter (fractional inset with stair and slab smoothing), raised corner ridges, and the keep on a much higher stone hill. Add the inner precinct walls with tiled caps, a masugata gate and yagura turrets.
Close the castle wall on the south side with a proper gatehouse, and give the wall a stone base, white plaster and a dark tile roof with eaves on both sides.
Make the moat and canal curve and add more red arched bridges, willows, stone embankments with steps, and boats.
Furnish the keep: tatami floors with borders, sliding fusuma walls, a raised shogun's dais with screens, armour stands, lanterns and painted panels.

problems.detail: The farewell in the show is the Merry engulfed in a roaring Viking-funeral blaze on a dark sea, with snow falling and the crew on the shore. Here the fire is a few scattered campfires and magma blocks that are barely visible in either render, so it reads as an ordinary moored ship.

problems.where: Straw Hat flag at the masthead
problems.detail: The flag is 1 block thick (z=CZ only), so from the other side the Jolly Roger reads backwards, which breaks the guide's rule that flags are 2 thick with the art drawn per side.
The hull below the main deck is solid planks. There is no hold, no men's quarters and no storeroom, only the small stern galley is furnished.

problems.detail: The shore is a flat lawn plus a flat gravel and stone strip with a tiny 5-block cairn, a slab bench and a row of lanterns on fences. There are no rocks, cliff, slope down to the water or snow.

top_fixes: Use canvas.square_sail (billowing, with a yard) for both sails with the Jolly Roger as its pattern, or give the custom sail a real 2-3 block belly that curves across the whole width and down to the clews.
Make the sea open: carve the water out to the build edges with a natural sloping shoreline (sand, then gravel, then rocks) instead of a walled rectangle. Let the beach shelve into the water.

Sell the funeral: many more campfires and fire on deck, scorched black planks spreading from the middle, smoke (signal campfires) up the mast, glowing magma in the hull seams, a partly burnt sail, and snow (snow layers and powder snow) on the shore.
Make the Straw Hat flag two blocks thick with the art written correctly on each side.
Hollow the hull into a hold with hammocks, barrels and Usopp's workshop, and add the men's quarters under the forecastle.
Give the shore a low rocky headland with the crew's lookout spot, boulders and a path down to the water.

problems.detail: About 75 identical small purple lollipop gloom trees 6-11 high, spread evenly. Thriller Bark's forest is twisted, huge and dense, with a thick mist and spooky silhouettes.

problems.where: Moria's castle at the stern x4-46
problems.detail: The castle is three stacked rectangular boxes (a wedding cake) with identical round towers and cones at every corner. It looks good from afar, but up close the faces are uniform pilaster-and-slot repetition with no buttresses, gables or flying arches.

CUTS = [] means no cut-away renders are made, so the castle, mansion and lab interiors are never checked. From the code, the castle ground floor is one 41x59x15 hall with only a few banners, paintings and lights.

The giant mast is a plain brown 7-wide log cylinder with no rigging, shrouds or crow's nest. The hull sides are uniform planks with a stripe, and the show's spooky arched bridge and the Wedding Hall are missing.

top_fixes: Make the sails billow: use canvas.square_sail or curve the belly in both directions (deepest in the centre, edges pinned to the yard and clews). Tear them with a few large ragged holes and frayed edges instead of 14% salt-and-pepper noise, and attach the top row to the yard face-to-face.

Sculpt the deck island: real hills (10-20 high), a ravine, a pond of murky water, the graveyard on a rise, and noise-blended ground patches (not per-block random). Wind the path instead of running it straight.
Make the forest spooky: varied, twisted gloom trees of very different sizes including a few giants, dense clusters with clearings, and low fog done with white stained glass or cobweb clusters.
Add rigging to the mast (shrouds, ratlines in chains, a crow's nest, a second yard) and give the hull wales, gunports and gilded stern galleries.

Add cuts, for example CUTS=[cb+2, cb+20], and furnish the castle: Moria's throne hall with columns, a balcony and chandeliers. Add Hogback's lab with operating tables and specimen jars, and the Wedding Hall.

problems.where: whole build in the world (ryan's screenshot, Foosha in game)

Its left side is a sheer cliff down to the sea, and the build's own sea (T.sea, z>62) is a dirt-walled pit with water in it, well above real sea level. The structure height comes from ONE heightmap sample at the start tile (the middle of the build). On a coast that point is inland and high, so the 84x80 plate, harbour and all, is lifted to that height, and beard_thin only fills a thin skirt under it.

problems.detail: A flat lawn with grass tufts and a dead-straight dirt street in a grid. The only relief is the three windmill knolls, which rise at most 3 blocks. Foosha in the anime is a hilly seaside village: houses step up the slope from the harbour, with low stone walls, flowers and fences between plots.

problems.where: Luffy's dinghy at the long pier (x 43-47, z ~71)
problems.detail: A hand-drawn flat 5x4 white_wool sail with a fence yard. It ignores canvas.square_sail, so it never billows.
problems.code_hint: build(): for x in range(mx-2,mx+3): for y in range(3,7): b.set(x,y,mz-1,'minecraft:white_wool')

problems.detail: Every cottage is a T.house box of nearly the same size (7-9 x 6-8) with the same brown roof, so the village reads as copies. There are no red/orange tiled roofs, no whitewashed walls, and no gardens or flower beds against the houses as in the anime.

Partys Bar is right: a 2-storey timber house with a big PARTYS BAR board. But the windmill sails render as empty brown frames with a little white, and the arms are 1 block thick. The anime mill has a bright white tower with a dark cap and wide sails covered in cloth. The mill towers are plain rings with 3 tiny windows.

top_fixes: Placement: for builds with their own sea, use sky_y = sea level (world 62/63) or OCEAN_FLOOR_WG sampled at a sea tile, not the centre tile. Better still, make the tiler choose a start tile whose ground is at y 0 and sits at the water's edge, so the quay meets real water. For inland builds, sample several points and use the lowest or the median, not one column
Give the ground real relief: gentle slopes rising 4-8 blocks inland from the beach, with stone retaining walls and stairs where the street climbs
Replace Luffy's flat wool sail with b.square_sail (it billows) and put a real hull under the mast
Vary the cottages: red/orange tile roofs, whitewashed walls, different footprints and heights, fenced gardens and flower beds
Fill the windmill sails with cloth (white_wool panels between thicker stocks) and add windows and a balcony on the towers

problems.where: ring of townhouses round the square
problems.detail: Every townhouse is the same 10x10 footprint (rows at a fixed 11-block step), 3-4 storeys, mostly the same dark brown roofs with a few deep red ones, and tall pink-brick chimney posts sticking up. The ring is perfectly square, so the 'square' is a courtyard of identical blocks.
Big empty plates of flat grey stone bricks fill the corners of the 100x100 tile (very visible from the NW). No streets lead out of the square.
A plain 7x7 brick shaft 26 high, with single-block 'clocks' (one white and one black block) and a small hip cap.

The scaffold is a stocky 11x11 X-braced cube. The stair props show from the NW as bare dark posts standing beside it. The anime scaffold is a tall, narrower platform with a long stair, and the square is surrounded by tall cream and orange buildings with arcades.
The base has good relief (pilasters, MARINE lettering), but the raised gull panel on the roof reads as a crude flat billboard.

top_fixes: Vary the townhouses: different widths (6-14), heights and roof shapes, with cream and orange plaster as in the anime, and arcades or awnings on the ground floor round the square
Break the square ring: streets leaving from each side, corner buildings, and stairs or a slope down to the harbour
Fill or cut the empty grey corners: more streets and houses, or let soften_edges take them
Make the clock tower a real tower: a clock face 5+ blocks wide on each side, a belfry with arches, a spire
Give the scaffold a slimmer, taller look with its stair as the main feature, and sink the stair props under the stringers so they don't read as loose posts

problems.detail: Dark oak, dark mangrove, a black sign board and a black BAR panel make the bar read as a black box under the trees. It is small against the 72x72 tile and hard to see from either corner, hidden by the Yarukiman canopies.
problems.code_hint: bar_house(): BAR panel black_concrete across the upper floor, board black_concrete

problems.detail: The anime Shakky's is a small cosy bar with a curved, rounded SHAKKY'S RIP-OFF BAR sign, warm lights and a door with steps, pressed against a mangrove. Here the board is a flat rectangle on the roof, and the BAR panel covers all the upstairs windows on the front.
A big empty flat lawn with tufts around the bar. The 'terrace under the roots' is three tables on grass, and no mangrove root arches over the bar.
The bubbles are solid light-blue lumps of 3-5 blocks. They read as ice blocks, not bubbles.
A plain T.house shack.

top_fixes: Lighten the bar: warm mangrove or birch infill, lit windows on the front, a lighter sign board with a curved top
Bring a big root of the Grove 13 mangrove over and around the bar, so it is nestled as the docstring says, and put the terrace under that root
Make the bubbles hollow spheres of glass (or bubble_glass) of different sizes, some rising from the roots
Fill the lawn: a root-floored ground with mangrove planks, coating barrels, a bubble-coated boat at the dock
Make the coating workshop a proper yard with a slipway and a ship being coated

problems.detail: The main island, the tower pillar and the gate rock are perfectly flat ellipses of grey stone brick or andesite with vertical cylinder cliffs. There is no relief, no stairs between levels and no gardens; most of the main island is empty grey paving.
problems.code_hint: island_top(): b.set(x, 0, z, 'stone_bricks' or 'polished_andesite') for every inside column

problems.detail: About 25 identical townhouse boxes with black pyramid roofs in a tight grid, in three colours (cream, pink, white).
Two huge flat concrete planes in a deepslate frame, with the emblem outlined and thin bands. They are a black billboard from both sides, with no door relief, no hinge pillars and no massive frame.

problems.where: drawbridge chains and the Bridge of Hesitation
problems.detail: The drawbridge chains are b.line diagonal chain lines, so the steps touch only at corners and read as dotted lines. The Bridge of Hesitation shows as a spiky grey wall-post skeleton near the gates, not a deck. The finish pass also removed 70 floating carpets and lanterns inside the tower.

problems.detail: Each floor is a big empty 31x31 square hall with scattered furniture from one furnish() call. There are no corridors, rooms, stairs or Lucci's hall layout.
The whole 224x224 site is a square basin with straight waterfall walls on four sides, which reads as a square box in the world.

top_fixes: Give the islands relief: raised terraces and stairs on the main island, a rocky, craggy pillar under the tower, plazas and gardens instead of empty paving
Vary the town (different footprints and heights, arcades, roofs of different shapes), and leave a grand boulevard from the Main Gate to the Courthouse
Give the Gates of Justice depth: panels inset 2-3 blocks, hinge columns, a massive stepped frame, and the emblem in relief
Make the drawbridge chains straight vertical or 45-degree runs that connect block to block, and make the Bridge of Hesitation a solid deck with railings
Split the tower floors into rooms and corridors with a grand stair, and build Lucci's top-floor hall
Make the rim of the hole round, or irregular with the sea pouring in, not a square box

problems.detail: The skull is a perfect smooth calcite ellipsoid, an egg with two eye holes and a nose triangle. problems.detail: kit.B.ship draws its sails as a flat 1-block plane split by the mast (black and grey rectangles). These do not use canvas.square_sail, so the sails don't billow. The hulls are blunt.
The ground is concentric 1-block terraces from int(10 - d/5) that read as contour rings. The top block is random from 7 materials per cell, so the ground is speckled noise rather than rock.

problems.detail: The cranium is a huge hollow drum. The finish pass hung dozens of long chains with lanterns from the dome ceiling, so the throne level looks like a cage of bars. The throne is a small obsidian lump.
problems.code_hint: finish.lighting adds chains in tall rooms; throne = few obsidian blocks

problems.detail: Sixteen similar gable-roof shacks sit on a list of spots. Few stilts show, and there are no boardwalks, stairs up the rock, taverns with signs or market.

The anime's Hachinosu is a rugged pirate island under an enormous skull-shaped crag of dark, weathered rock, with a lawless port town crammed up the rocks. The clean, egg-white skull and the flat island miss the menace.

top_fixes: Sculpt the skull properly: brow ridge, deep eye sockets, sunken temples, cheekbones, and a jaw with teeth open at ground level. Use weathered stone and bone colours, with moss and cracks.
Cut the terrain away in front of the mouth so the cave entrance is a visible plaza, and replace the ring terraces with craggy noise rock.
Redraw both ships' sails with canvas.square_sail so they billow, and give them proper hull shapes.
Swap the hanging-chain forest for a few big chandeliers or wall braziers, and build a real raised throne on a dais with banners.
Stack the shacks up the rocks with stilts, boardwalks and ladders, and add signs, lanterns and barrels.

problems.detail: The 36x28 ground floor is one vast red-and-yellow patterned carpet with a small stair-down block in the middle. There are no toy shelves, displays, columns, counters or toys.
The factory is a plain grey hollow box with a grid of white blocks and iron posts. It doesn't read as conveyor lines, vats and chutes, and the canal port is a thin strip.
The roof is flat concentric red/yellow slab rings, a striped stepped pyramid. It reads as a target pattern, with no eaves or dormers.
The garden is a flat empty lawn with three lone trees. The toy soldiers stand in a rigid grid on a short orange path.

The colourful toy-block look, the towers and the clock face are a good start. But Dressrosa's Toy House sits in a lively town plaza with cobbles, flowers and toys everywhere, and has a big colourful sign. Here it stands alone in a field.

top_fixes: Fill the show room with toy shelves, display stands, a central carousel or toy-train track, columns with colourful caps and hanging lanterns.
Make the factory read: conveyor belts (rails, observers, trapdoors), big SMILE vats with stairs and catwalks, crates on pallets, a proper quay with boats.
Give the roof real slopes and eaves with colourful dormers in place of the bullseye rings.
Set the house in a Dressrosa plaza: cobbles, a fountain, flower beds, stalls, and toy soldiers in groups, not a grid.

problems.detail: The pink 'Punk Records' sphere floats in mid-air over the top floor. The finish pass reports 'big floating part kept=1' and 'hung floating part from ceiling=1', and 71 floating bits were removed elsewhere.
problems.where: CX, FLOORS[-1]+12, CZ (pink blob inside the egg top)

problems.detail: The 'egg' reads as a grey faceted ball (light-grey panel mix, wide and round) with its top sliced off flat. In the show the Labophase is a clean white egg, taller than wide, with a jagged hatched crack, standing high over the island. Punk Records is a brain-shaped cloud tethered above it by a chain/stem. The Frontier Dome cloud ring, Fabriophase factory and the bright futuristic island are all missing.
Inside the egg (cut50) the labs are a small square box of four rooms round the elevator, floating in a huge empty spherical void. The shell and the rooms do not relate.
problems.code_hint: 'lab partitions: a square of rooms round the elevator'

problems.detail: Faustphase is seven identical quartz dome pods with a cyan band, dropped on a flat lawn in a ring. They have no varying sizes, connecting walkways, antennae, conveyors or holographic signage.
problems.code_hint: pod_lab(b, cx, cz, r, h, ...) with b.dome(... QUARTZ)

problems.detail: The island interior is a flat grass lawn cut by white radial paths. Egghead in the show is a stacked island of levels and terraces with futuristic structures everywhere, not a park.
The trees are tiny green cubes on sticks and the 'Seraphim pods' are 1x1 blue/black posts. The Pacifista line is a grey slab roof on posts over a black strip. All are sparse and toy-like.

top_fixes: Re-shape the egg: white smooth quartz/white concrete, taller than wide (ry > rx), with a jagged broken eggshell rim at the crack and a few large curved window bands. Raise it on a tall slender stem from a stepped plinth.
Make Punk Records a brain/cloud mass (white and pink wool blobs) tethered to the egg top by a thick stalk or chain column, so it is attached, not floating.
Fill the egg interior properly: several full-width floors following the shell curve, an atrium, labs with consoles round the rim, and no empty void.
Terrace the island into 2-3 levels with ramps and stairs. Vary the pods (sizes, stacked pods, tubes and bridges between them) and add a Fabriophase factory block with pipes and chimneys.
Add the cloud ring (Frontier Dome) as a white wool/snow fringe around the edge, plus a few big futuristic trees (rounded, layered leaves) instead of cubes.

problems.detail: Rainbase around the casino is the same alubarna.house sandstone boxes (no windows, crenellated flat roofs) lined up in rows round a flat sand square. It drags the whole build down.

The ground inside is flat sand with a 1-in-11 smooth sandstone speckle. The smooth sandstone tops are not in pipeline.GROUND, which probably blocks the softening.

problems.detail: The RAIN DINNERS sign is a single flat board. From the back (NW view) it is a blank red wall with a gold frame. The pyramid faces are one repeating stripe of sandstone and slab with gold ridges: no window bands, entrances or relief.

The casino hall (cut5) is a large empty sandstone floor with a few small tables, two bars and some posts. It needs slots, roulette and card tables in rows, a carpet pattern, columns and chandeliers. The seastone cage room under the lake (cut-6) is a bare teal box with a red line: no cage, no glass wall looking into the Bananawani water, no furnishings.
problems.where: y1..; cage room under the lake
problems.code_hint: 'ground floor: the casino hall' and 'seastone cage room' sections

problems.detail: The Bananawani statue is recognisable (good), but its body is a lumpy drape and the tail and legs fade into the slope. It is the strongest anime element, so it deserves more shape.

top_fixes: Fix the shared alubarna.house (see nanohana_port), then give Rainbase streets of varied, domed and arched desert houses with winding lanes and a little market, not a ring of boxes.

Make the sign two-sided (text on both faces, or a sign tower) and add relief to the pyramid: window bands of glass/gold, a grand entrance portal with columns and an awning, and gold banding at each step.
Fill the casino: patterned carpet floor, rows of slot machines (droppers or note blocks with lamps), roulette and card tables, a central chandelier and a raised VIP stair with a gold railing.
Build the seastone cage room as in the show: a cage of prison bars on a dais in Crocodile's room, with a big glass wall looking into the lake full of Bananawani.
Make the ground blocks soften-friendly (or add smooth_sandstone to GROUND) so the square plate edge disappears, and add dunes and oasis planting around the town.

problems.detail: The valley is a dead-flat plate of random coarse dirt, podzol, rooted dirt and packed mud: no valley slopes, cracked earth or dried riverbed. soften_edges left out 0 columns (the coarse_dirt top is not in pipeline.GROUND), so the square plate edge stays.

The dead-tree branches step diagonally (y0 + j//2), so pieces touch only by an edge: 144 floating bits were removed and the trees are left as bare poles with stubs. There is also a floating dirt block below the south rim, and 'big floating part kept=1'.
problems.where: dead trees ring r26..46; SE view (468,770)

problems.detail: The 'withered' Wano houses get 14 random AIR blocks punched into the roof band (y7-9) per house. This leaves pinholes and floating roof pieces rather than slipped tiles. The roofs read as flat navy hip pyramids with no curve, ridge or gable ornament.

problems.detail: The giant tree's crown is nine clean leaf spheres (one big, eight round blobs on straight branches): lollipop topiary, not a wild ancient canopy. The dead trees are white pale-oak poles that look like birch, not withered grey-brown husks.

problems.detail: The Marine camp tents are rigid wool wedges and the flag is a flat one-block banner, with no sag, guy ropes or pegs.

In Wano, Ryokugyu drains the life from everything into himself and sprouts as a huge tree and forest giant. The withered land should show dried, dead villagers' remains, grey shrivelled trees and sun-cracked earth around one huge living tree that strangles it with roots. Roots here are present but the crown, ground and houses do not sell it.

top_fixes: Fix dead_tree so each branch step is face-connected, use darker withered wood (stripped dark oak, mangrove roots, dead coral fans as twigs), and make the trees crooked and leaning.
Give the crown irregular, layered canopy clusters of different sizes with noise, drooping vines and hanging roots, not nine spheres.

Shape the ground: gentle valley slopes, cracked dry earth (mud/packed mud/coarse dirt patterns), a dried stream bed, and roots heaving the ground up near the tree. Use ground blocks soften_edges recognises so the plate edge goes away.
Damage the Wano houses structurally (a sagging roof corner, missing tile rows, broken shoji, collapsed veranda) instead of random pinholes. Give them proper curved Wano roofs with ridge caps.
Make the Marine tents canvas that sags (stair/slab edges), with poles, guy ropes and a two-sided Marine flag.

problems.where: Oris Plaza and the whole platform

problems.where: HQ tiers and the side barracks
problems.detail: The tiers are huge flat white walls with a mechanically even grid of identical small panes. The barracks are plain boxes under hip roofs. The 海[gull]軍 sign is the best part.

The real HQ is much taller and narrower, a soaring keep with big stacked roofs and the 海軍 sign high up, rising over a crescent bay. Here it is a wide stepped pyramid. The Encircling Wall should be tall, smooth siege walls lining the whole bay edge. Here it is short separate panels with gaps. The execution scaffold is small. The Marine town behind HQ is missing.
All three use B.ship: flat, split sails with no yards. The hulls are small, brown-decked and plain, nothing like Marine battleships with a gull figurehead.

problems.detail: From outside, the build is a perfect 100x100 square of flat sand with a smooth glass dome in the middle and random sea pickles. problems.detail: The bubble is a perfectly smooth ellipsoid shell of bubble glass with nothing outside it: no tube or bubble connection to Fish-Man Island, no coral or rock anchoring its base, no gate tunnel. Seen from the sea it is just a blue dome.

The 12 bubble lamps at radius 26 are set at FLOOR+10 (y -2) with one chain block above them, but the bubble roof at that radius is at about y +5. They hang 6 blocks short of anything, and the finish pass had to add 28 chains.
problems.where: ring of lamps r=26 around the centre

problems.detail: The town is dense and the houses are well framed, but every roof is the same teal prismarine gable, so the slum looks orderly and uniform. The anime Fish-Man District is a dark, run-down ghetto of crooked, crumbling coral houses with graffiti, broken walls, rubble, spiralling shell-shaped buildings and shadowed lanes. Hody's hideout and the Otohime memorial barely read.
The rooms are only 3 high with generic furnish() kinds. The den is a deepslate box subdivided into four rooms. There is no Energy Steroid lab detail and no shark-themed décor.

top_fixes: Replace the square sand plate with a natural seabed: rock outcrops, coral reefs in several colours, kelp forests and sand ripples that fall off at the edges. Anchor the bubble in a rocky coral basin.
Add context outside the bubble: a coral-rock rim where it meets the seabed, a tunnel or bubble-tube gate, and a few broken structures and wrecks outside.
Hang every lamp from the bubble roof with a full chain to the glass, or mount the lamps on posts or house walls.

Vary the roofscape: shell and spiral roofs, broken and collapsed roofs, patched slabs, coral growth on walls, graffiti banners. Use darker light, cracked and mossy variants, and rubble in the lanes so it reads as a ruined ghetto.
Make Hody's den and the Otohime memorial clear focal points: a shark-jaw entrance, a raised plaza with the statue, and a lit market street.

problems.detail: Kaya's estate sits on a perfectly rectangular terrace raised one block (grass at y1 over dirt) with hard square edges. The rest of the village is flat at y0. Kaya's mansion is supposed to be on a hill above the village.

The 'steep slope road down to the north coast' is flat dirt path at y0 with a few fences. In the anime, the slope where Usopp fights Kuro's crew is a steep road down a cliff to the beach, and it is the iconic set piece. There is no cliff coast, no beach landing and no place where the Going Merry is handed over.

The mansion is a 33x27 white-concrete box. The facade treatment (pilasters, cornices, pavilion) helps, but the long side walls are still an even 3-block grid of glass panes in plain white concrete. There are no wings, no bay windows and no balconies, and the roof is one big black hip.
The village houses are randomly-styled T.house boxes laid out on a loose grid along straight paths. The orchard is a 5x2 grid of identical trees.

top_fixes: Put Kaya's mansion on a real hill: raise the estate on a gently sloping mound with retaining walls, stairs and a curving drive, instead of a 1-block rectangular plate.
Build the slope: a steep road cut into a cliff down to a sandy beach on the north coast, with fences, rocks and a landing where the Going Merry can be moored.
Add depth to the mansion: side wings or bays brought forward, balconies with balustrades, window shutters and planters, a stone ground floor, and dormers along the whole roof.
Lay the village out along a curving main street with varied plots, gardens and fences. Plant the orchard irregularly, and give Usopp's tree house platform and ladder some character.

problems.where: ropeway cable from the summit (46,52) down to Bighorn (26,66)
problems.detail: The cable is 140 single dark_oak_fence blocks placed along a steep diagonal. They touch only at corners, so they render as a dotted line of loose posts in the air (visible in both renders). There is no actual rope, no gondola and no pylon at mid-span.

The rock columns are concentric cylinders with a snow ring every 6 blocks and stone/andesite bands every 4. The pattern is perfectly regular and reads as a stack of tyres, not cliffs. The two side peaks are bare flat-topped drums.

The anime Drum Castle is tall and vertical, with many round towers of different heights and blue-grey conical roofs, snow on every roof, and the cherry-blossom snow around it. Here a wide low box with a black hip roof has four identical windowless white tube towers whose blue_terracotta cones render purple, and the 'onion' dome is a lumpy grey-purple blob. The roofs have no snow.

problems.detail: Eight identical wooden cabins packed tight in a grid, with snow stripes on the roofs.
The upper floor is subdivided by plain white partition walls; the rooms are small and similar.

top_fixes: Make the ropeway a continuous cable: chains placed so every block touches the next, or a fence line that steps one block at a time, sagging; add a pylon and a gondola
Break up the rock columns: an irregular radius per angle (crags, overhangs), uneven snow ledges and icicles, not rings every 6 blocks
Make the castle more vertical: towers of 2-3 different heights with windows, light-blue or grey cone roofs with snow, a proper onion dome on the main tower
Put snow on all roofs and parapets, and let the pink snow spill onto the castle roofs
Vary Bighorn: different cabin sizes, a larger inn, fences, firewood, and streets that wind instead of a grid

problems.detail: The hull is a long rectangle with vertical sides, a flat deck and a blunt, box-like bow and stern. There is no sheer (the deck rising to bow and stern), tumblehome, curved transom, stern windows gallery or quarter galleries. From the side it looks like a barge.

problems.detail: The masthead flags are light-blue wool boxes with a white middle, not the Marine flag (white with the blue gull and 'MARINE'). The seagull figurehead is a white lump with a yellow stick for a beak.

problems.detail: The figurehead wings are single-block diagonal lines (k//2, k//3 steps) that connect only by edges and look like scattered debris. problems.detail: The weather deck is an empty plank field: no hatches, capstan, deck cannons, lifeboats, coiled ropes, barrels or crates. The stern castle is a plain white box with 1x1 windows, and the bridge is a small box.
problems.where: deck y DECK+1; stern castle S0..S1

problems.detail: The sails billow, but they read as stacks of grey ledges with yards sticking out, and three sails per mast with the same depth crowd together. There is no bowsprit jib or spanker sail.

top_fixes: Give the hull a sheer line (deck 2-3 higher at bow and stern), a rounded, raked bow that narrows to the figurehead, a tumblehome curve and a proper stern with a window gallery, the MARINE name and lanterns.
Build a real seagull figurehead: a sculpted head with eyes, a big yellow beak and solid wings swept back along the bow, all face-connected.
Use the Marine flag (white, blue gull, two-sided) at the mastheads. Paint 'MARINE' plus the gull on the big main course sails, and add a jib on the bowsprit and a spanker aft.
Replace the fence-line rigging with continuous shrouds/ratlines (chains or fences that step face-connected) down to channels on the hull side.
Dress the deck: hatches with gratings, a capstan, deck cannons on carriages, lifeboats on davits, barrels, coiled ropes, and a taller bridge with windows.

problems.where: the street rings of every tier and the large dock apron east and south-east of HQ
problems.detail: Every tier is a flat grey cobble plate with a regular light-dash pattern, and houses sit on it far apart in empty space. Water 7 is dense, with houses wall to wall along canals and bridges. Here the outer ring is mostly bare paving.
